recipe.visualDefinition: A formal, symmetrical group portrait featuring a central male figure seated on an ornate black throne, surrounded by four children in formal attire. The scene is set against a weathered, golden sandstone wall etched with large-scale Egyptian hieroglyphics and relief carvings, blending modern luxury with ancient iconography.
coreVisualRelationships: Centralized hierarchy with the father as the visual anchor
Contrast between the deep black of the throne/clothing and the golden background
Juxtaposition of modern high-fashion jewelry with ancient architectural motifs
Symmetrical arrangement of children creating a balanced triangular composition
coreInvariants: Sandstone wall with deep-etched hieroglyphic textures
Warm, directional lighting creating soft shadows on the floor
Formal, stoic expressions from all subjects

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The father is seated centrally at medium scale; children are positioned at his sides and feet to form a pyramid shape.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The ornate black throne and the central seated figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the central figure's face, moves down to the children at the base, then upward along the vertical lines of the hieroglyphic wall.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the background is densely textured with carvings, though the floor provides a neutral grounding area.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Ochre and gold (background and floor) providing a warm, monochromatic base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep obsidian black (throne and suits) for sharp silhouette definition.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white and silver (dresses and jewelry) to catch highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark foreground elements and the light, textured background.

letterConstructionRules: High contrast between thick and thin strokes

treatment.depth: subtle inner glow to mimic carving

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used with varying tracking to maintain a clean, archival look.

candidateDirections.reason: Classical Roman proportions that complement ancient themes.
Standard for cinematic and regal titling.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-resolution photograph of a man on a black throne with four children, set against a golden Egyptian sandstone wall with hieroglyphics. The lighting should be warm and cinematic.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the title in a small, wide-tracked serif font at the top center, using a color that matches the darkest shadows of the stone carvings to make it look engraved.

verificationChecks: Is the text centered and small?
Does the text have wide tracking?
Is the font a clean serif?
Does the text color blend with the stone texture?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the throne is solid black and glossy.
Check that the hieroglyphics look carved, not just printed.
Verify the triangular composition of the subjects.
Confirm the text is legible but subtle.
Ensure the floor texture transitions naturally from the wall.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central figure + Ornate Throne + Symmetrical Grouping + Ancient Architectural Backdrop + Wide-Tracked Serif Typography.
